prescription.title: Prescription Reader, Verification & Reminders
prescription.subtitle: Scan prescriptions, verify exact dosages, and establish active medication reminders safely.
prescription.upload_desc: Take a flat, well-lit, glare-free picture or PDF of your doctor's written prescription slip.
prescription.empty_desc: Upload your doctor's prescription to verify medicine schedules and activate adherence reminders.
prescription.doctor_note: Always follow the explicit written instructions of your prescribing physician.
prescription.scanning_desc: Parsing doctor notes, drug names, strengths, timings, and identifying unclear sections.
prescription.verification_notice: Please verify the extracted prescription details against your original prescription before creating reminders.
prescription.reminders_created_success: Medication schedule and reminders created successfully!
prescription.missed_dose_advisory: Missed medication reminder: Follow your prescription or healthcare professional's instructions. Never take a double dose.
prescription.safety_mandate: DERMASATHIAI does not modify prescribed dosages, recommend substitutes, or invent medication frequencies. Always follow your prescribing doctor's orders.

lifestyle.title: Skin Lifestyle & Barrier Care
lifestyle.subtitle: Daily routines, sun defense, and habits to support long-term epidermal health.
lifestyle.barrier_desc: Avoid scalding water and harsh foaming detergents. Apply moisturizing emollients within 3 minutes of bathing.
lifestyle.sun_desc: Broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen protects against UVA/UVB barrier degradation even on overcast Indian monsoon days.
lifestyle.hydration_desc: Drink 2.5-3 liters of clean water daily and consume water-rich seasonal produce like cucumber and melon.
lifestyle.sleep_desc: 7-8 hours of quality sleep reduces systemic cortisol that triggers inflammatory skin breakouts.

emergency.title: Emergency & Red-Flag Triage
emergency.subtitle: Immediate danger signs for life-threatening skin conditions (SJS/TEN, Anaphylaxis).

emergency.flag_breath: Shortness of breath or difficulty breathing
emergency.flag_peel: Skin peeling off in sheets or sores in mouth/eyes
emergency.flag_fever: High fever accompanying rapid skin redness
emergency.flag_pain: Extreme burning pain that cannot be touched
